reasoning: The glyph literally shows three ring-topped posts crossed by a wavy line (originally designed as Quidditch goal hoops, though visually very close to acupuncture needles in skin or loop-headed sewing pins in fabric). Because few people recognize the exact symbol without a label, it works only for narrow tasks like acupuncture/dry needling, pinning sewing projects, or Harry Potter/Quidditch events.
